exposure: Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) exposure during pregnancy and breastfeeding
Azathioprine (AZA) exposure during pregnancy and breastfeeding
cohort: Children (up to 17 years old) born to mothers with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) who attended UK specialist lupus clinics.
finding: Exposure to Azathioprine (AZA) during pregnancy and breastfeeding was associated with an increased risk of childhood infection requiring hospital management, while Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) exposure showed no significant negative outcomes.
